history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young East Asian woman with long, wavy black hair and fair skin stands in a lush green outdoor setting. She is wearing a bright yellow, oversized knit cardigan with bell sleeves and distressed details, layered over a white ruched camisole and light grey shorts with a white ruffled overlay. Her hands are raised, framing her head. The background features manicured green grass, a stone wall, and mature trees with dense green foliage under a bright, slightly overcast sky. The lighting is natural and soft, creating a gentle illumination. The overall mood is serene and fashionable, with a focus on a youthful, aesthetic style. The color palette is dominated by vibrant greens and the striking yellow of the cardigan, contrasted with the whites and greys of her outfit. The image has a high-fashion, lifestyle photography feel.
